envelope.description: Simplify jetbrains-plugin's ScriptDaemonProvisioner.run(UPDATE): remove the legacy/existingUpgradeTarget() branch

body.title: Simplify jetbrains-plugin's ScriptDaemonProvisioner.run(UPDATE): remove the legacy/existingUpgradeTarget() branch
body.summary: Remove run(kind)'s legacy branch for UPDATE (computed from locator.existingUpgradeTarget()) so UPDATE always resolves via locator.scriptFor(UPDATE) and spawns 'bash <daemon-ctl.sh> update'. Remove the now-dead DaemonLifecycleService.existingUpgradeTarget() override and the DaemonScriptLocator interface's existingUpgradeTarget() default, since nothing calls it anymore.
acceptanceChecks: ScriptDaemonProvisioner.run(ProvisionKind.UPDATE, ...) on an unmanaged install always spawns 'bash <daemon-ctl.sh> update', never the bundled installer with --target.

tests.name: jetbrains-plugin/src/test/kotlin/ai/insors/insrc/jetbrains/lifecycle/DaemonLifecycleCommandRunnerTest.kt (rewritten: the legacy branch it currently exercises via INSRC_ROUTE_MATRIX_* env vars is removed)
